- Add a committed public API export/signature/default/result-field contract, real invalid-type and shell-injection probes, workflow token/trusted-checkout checks, and an explicit offline safety suite covering consent, paths, freezing, privacy, redaction, replay, publication and layering.
- CI now explicitly uses read-only contents permissions. OpenCode per-role file ACLs remain uninstalled and are not claimed as covered; see the coverage document.

Declare/review mypy, Bandit and defusedxml; include the requested AI-use log. No model calls, token-budget change or semantic acceptance claim.
